21.name: FTP
21.why: Cleartext file transfer; credentials and data travel unencrypted.
21.fix: Disable FTP; use SFTP/FTPS restricted to management networks.

23.name: Telnet
23.why: Cleartext remote shell, a classic entry point for IoT compromise.
23.fix: Disable Telnet; use SSH with key-based auth on a management network.

445.name: SMB
445.why: File-sharing protocol with a long history of remote exploits.
445.fix: Do not expose SMB to untrusted networks; patch and restrict by firewall.

1883.name: MQTT (plain)
1883.why: Unencrypted MQTT broker; often deployed without authentication.
1883.fix: Require authentication and TLS (port 8883); restrict by firewall.

3389.name: RDP
3389.why: Remote desktop exposed to the network is a frequent ransomware vector.
3389.fix: Place behind VPN or a zero-trust gateway; enforce MFA and NLA.

5900.name: VNC
5900.why: Remote desktop protocol, often weak or no authentication.
5900.fix: Disable or tunnel through VPN/SSH; enforce strong authentication.

6379.name: Redis
6379.why: In-memory datastore that is unauthenticated by default in many setups.
6379.fix: Bind to localhost or a private interface; enable ACLs and requirepass.

9200.name: Elasticsearch
9200.why: Search/data API frequently exposed without authentication.
9200.fix: Enable security features and restrict network access.

27017.name: MongoDB
27017.why: Database port; historically exposed without authentication.
27017.fix: Enable authentication; bind to private interfaces only.

502.name: Modbus/TCP
502.why: Industrial protocol with no built-in authentication or encryption.
502.fix: Never expose to the internet; segment OT networks and use a gateway.

554.name: RTSP
554.why: Camera video streams are often exposed without authentication.
554.fix: Require authentication and restrict to the VMS network.

102.name: Siemens S7comm
102.why: Industrial PLC protocol without authentication or encryption.
102.fix: Never expose to untrusted networks; segment OT and use a controlled gateway.

2375.name: Docker API (plain)
2375.why: Unauthenticated Docker daemon API gives full control of the host.
2375.fix: Disable the TCP listener or require mutual TLS; bind to a Unix socket.

3306.name: MySQL
3306.why: Database port reachable from the network.
3306.fix: Bind to private interfaces and restrict by firewall; require TLS.

5432.name: PostgreSQL
5432.why: Database port reachable from the network.
5432.fix: Restrict via pg_hba.conf and firewall; require TLS.

5984.name: CouchDB
5984.why: Database HTTP API frequently exposed with weak or no authentication.
5984.fix: Enable authentication and restrict network access.

11211.name: Memcached
11211.why: Cache service with no authentication by default.
11211.fix: Bind to localhost or private interface; firewall the port.

20000.name: DNP3
20000.why: Industrial protocol with no built-in authentication in common deployments.
20000.fix: Keep inside the OT network; use a secure gateway.

44818.name: EtherNet/IP
44818.why: Industrial protocol with no built-in authentication.
44818.fix: Never expose to untrusted networks; segment OT.
